instruction: I am studying the timezone distribution of three machine learning conferences (ICLR, ICML, Neurips) from 2013 to 2019. I have set up a table with conference names and years. Please research and fill in the timezone for each conference location in the City column.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
